events.outcome: Current official support separates a 180-day chargeable-use rule from a 180-day top-up/plan credit rule; the old £5/180-day model is not safe to publish as a settled minimum.

data.acquisitionSummary: Free SIM from mobile.asda.com (UK delivery). PAYG rates 15p/min, 10p/text, 10p/MB on Vodafone network. 4G only unless spending >=£10/mo.

keep.action: Use a chargeable call, text or data event within each 180-day period to keep the line fully active; separately, account credit is restricted after 180 days without a top-up or plan purchase and expires after a further 90 days. Exact cheapest sustainable cost remains unreconciled.
